nodes.name: github/commands/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that wires together and re-exports the GitHub command submodules (shared, repos, pulls, issues, credentials) so their `#[tauri::command]` functions register under a single `github::commands::*` path.

nodes.name: github/commands/pulls.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands and response models covering the full GitHub pull-request lifecycle: create/find/list PRs, commits and files, reviews and inline review comments, and rolled-up CI check status.

nodes.name: github/commands/repos.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands and response models for listing, searching, and creating GitHub repositories and branches, plus fetching raw file content from a repo.

nodes.name: github/commands/shared.rs
nodes.summary: Shared helpers used by every GitHub command module: resolves the active HTTPS credential token from the centralized connection-token store and constructs an authenticated GitHubClient.

nodes.name: github/detect.rs
nodes.summary: Scans the local system for existing GitHub credentials -- gh CLI config, SSH public keys, and git credential-helper output -- to pre-populate the Connections setup wizard.

nodes.name: github/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root that declares and re-exports the GitHub integration's client, commands, detect, and profile submodules.

nodes.name: github/profile.rs
nodes.summary: Fetches a GitHub user's full profile (repos, language stats, commit history, top repos) concurrently on the client, replacing a slow server-side Python implementation that generated hundreds of serial API requests.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses buffer_unordered(10) to fan out repo/commit-history requests concurrently instead of serially, and runs parallel per-year GraphQL queries for commit history.

nodes.name: get_paginated_array
nodes.summary: Fetches and concatenates every page of a top-level-array GitHub API endpoint via conditional GETs.

nodes.name: get_paginated_field_array
nodes.summary: Fetches and concatenates every page of a named-field array from a paginated GitHub API endpoint.

nodes.name: github_create_pr
nodes.summary: Tauri command that creates a new pull request from a head/base branch pair, title, body, and draft flag.

nodes.name: github_find_pull_request
nodes.summary: Tauri command that looks up an existing open pull request for a given head branch.

nodes.name: github_list_prs
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists a repository's pull requests filtered by state.

nodes.name: github_get_pr
nodes.summary: Tauri command that fetches a single pull request's details.

nodes.name: github_list_pr_commits
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists the commits belonging to a pull request.

nodes.name: github_list_pr_files
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists the files changed by a pull request.

nodes.name: parse_pr_review
nodes.summary: Parses a raw GitHub API JSON value into a GitHubPrReview struct.

nodes.name: parse_review_comment
nodes.summary: Parses a raw GitHub API JSON value into a GitHubReviewComment struct, including inline diff position fields.

nodes.name: parse_check_run
nodes.summary: Parses a raw GitHub API JSON value into a GitHubCheckRun struct.

nodes.name: parse_status_context
nodes.summary: Parses a raw GitHub API JSON value into a GitHubStatusContext struct.

nodes.name: roll_up_checks_state
nodes.summary: Aggregates individual CI check-run and commit-status results into a single overall pass/fail/pending state.

nodes.name: github_list_pr_reviews
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists the reviews submitted on a pull request.

nodes.name: github_list_pr_review_comments
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists inline review comments on a pull request.

nodes.name: github_create_pr_review
nodes.summary: Tauri command that submits a top-level review (approve/request-changes/comment) on a pull request.

nodes.name: github_create_pr_review_comment
nodes.summary: Tauri command that posts an inline review comment on a specific line of a pull request diff.

nodes.name: github_reply_pr_review_comment
nodes.summary: Tauri command that replies to an existing inline review comment thread.

nodes.name: github_get_checks
nodes.summary: Tauri command that fetches and rolls up CI check-run and status results for a git ref.

nodes.name: parse_repo
nodes.summary: Parses a raw GitHub API JSON value into a Repo struct.

nodes.name: clean_repo_path
nodes.summary: Normalizes a repository-relative file path extracted from a remote URL.

nodes.name: github_repo_full_name_from_remote
nodes.summary: Tauri command that extracts an `owner/repo` full name from a git remote URL.

nodes.name: parse_search_repo
nodes.summary: Parses a raw GitHub search-API JSON value into a SearchRepo struct.

nodes.name: github_search_repos
nodes.summary: Tauri command that searches GitHub repositories by query with sort and pagination options.

nodes.name: github_list_repos
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists the authenticated user's repositories with pagination.

nodes.name: github_list_branches
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists a repository's branches.

nodes.name: github_create_branch
nodes.summary: Tauri command that creates a new branch from a given base SHA.

nodes.name: github_get_content
nodes.summary: Tauri command that fetches a repository file's raw content (with binary/truncation detection) at a given ref.

nodes.name: SearchRepo
nodes.summary: Repository search-result data model returned by GitHub's repo search API, including owner, fork/archive flags, and topics.

nodes.name: resolve_token
nodes.summary: Resolves the active HTTPS credential token from the centralized connection-token store, or returns the canonical GitHubReAuthRequired error.

nodes.name: make_client
nodes.summary: Constructs an authenticated GitHubClient using the resolved HTTPS token; called by nearly every GitHub command handler.

nodes.name: detect_github_credentials
nodes.summary: Tauri command that aggregates gh CLI, SSH key, and git credential-helper detection results into a single DetectedGitHubCredentials response.

nodes.name: detect_gh_cli
nodes.summary: Reads the gh CLI's hosts.yml config file to detect an existing gh CLI login.

nodes.name: extract_gh_cli_token
nodes.summary: Extracts the OAuth token from gh CLI's hosts.yml content.

nodes.name: extract_gh_cli_username
nodes.summary: Extracts the logged-in username from gh CLI's hosts.yml content.

nodes.name: detect_ssh_keys
nodes.summary: Scans ~/.ssh/ for public key files and extracts their type and comment.

nodes.name: probe_credential_helper
nodes.summary: Invokes the configured git credential helper to probe for stored GitHub credentials.

nodes.name: detect_credential_helper
nodes.summary: Determines which git credential helper is configured and probes it for GitHub credentials.

nodes.name: detect_git_credentials_file
nodes.summary: Checks whether the global git-credentials file contains a github.com entry.

nodes.name: fetch_profile_internal
nodes.summary: Fetches the authenticated user's profile, repos, language stats, commit history, and top repos concurrently and assembles the combined ProfileData response.

nodes.name: fetch_all_repos
nodes.summary: Fetches every page of the user's repositories via conditional GETs.

nodes.name: aggregate_language_stats
nodes.summary: Fans out per-repo language-byte-count requests concurrently and aggregates them into overall language percentages.

nodes.name: fetch_commit_history
nodes.summary: Runs parallel per-year GraphQL contribution queries to build a multi-year commit-count history for a user.

nodes.name: fetch_top_repos
nodes.summary: Fetches the user's top repositories ranked by stargazer count via a GraphQL query.
